extraction.name: Arabic-Nougat (arabic-img2md dataset)
extraction.description: Arabic-Nougat is a suite of OCR models designed to convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text. The associated dataset, arabic-img2md, consists of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, generated by scraping HTML from the Hindawi website. Additionally, arabic-books, a large-scale dataset of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens extracted from over 8,500 books, is released.
extraction.license: open-source (all models and datasets are open-sourced, available at https://github.com/MohamedAliRashad/arabic-nougat)
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad, Faculty of Engineering Ain Shams University, Cairo, Egypt
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to generate paired Arabic book page images and Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website, converted to PDFs and paired with Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: HTML content from the Hindawi website was scraped, converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted to create paired image-Markdown samples.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi's web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may not generalize to other Arabic text domains (scientific, religious, historical). Models exhibit hallucination and repetition issues. Performance on multilingual or mixed-script documents has not been extensively tested. Complex layouts with dense tables, charts, or images may require additional preprocessing.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluation of Arabic OCR models; downstream NLP tasks using the arabic-books dataset; Arabic document parsing and Markdown extraction.
